name: Secure container Alpha
description: Everything in it stays yours when you die. Holds 2×2; no rigs, backpacks or other containers.

name: Secure container Beta
description: A bigger secure container: 3×2. Built at the Workbench (level 3) from an Alpha.

name: Secure container Gamma
description: A 3×3 secure container. Prapor hands it over once you've proven you can keep things safe (Safekeeping).

name: Secure container Kappa
description: The biggest secure container, 3×4. Skier's reward for the Collector's Case.
